title: Search for Alignment of Disk Orientations in Nearby Star-forming Regions: Lupus, Taurus, Upper Scorpius, ρ Ophiuchi, and Orion
question: Are proto-planetary disk orientations (position angles) mutually aligned in five nearby star-forming regions (Lupus, Taurus, Upper Sco, Ophiuchus, Orion)?

data.bands: Lupus continuum typical ~335 GHz; comparison dataset Band 6
data.angular_resolution: typical beam 0.34'' x 0.28'' (Lupus, Ansdell+2016); ~0.25'' for Ansdell+2018

what.value: Lupus disk PAs (0-360 deg, from CO spectroscopy) and cos i

evidence.quote: In the current analysis, we adopt PA estimated by (cite: 2018A&A...616A.100Y) instead of those from continuum images.
we adopt PA estimated by (cite: 2017ApJ...851...85B), which presents disk parameters in their Table 1.
We adopt the values of PA listed in their Table 4.

external_data.citation: Cox et al. 2017; Cieza et al. 2019

evidence.quote: We use the values of PA listed in their Tables 1 and 2.
We compile the values of PA published in previous literature
Table D.1 of (cite: 2016A&A...586A.138P) shows that $\sigma_{\psi} = 36^{\circ}\pm0.1^{\circ}$ in the Orion region

recipe.goal: Compile PAs per region and select disks
recipe.method: Take published PAs; keep disks with PA error <30 deg; Lupus III members selected 3D with Gaia parallax; Oph overlapping disks handled by choosing one catalog or the other; exclude face-on disks
assumptions: Disk circular, cos i = minor/major axis ratio

recipe.method: Kuiper test against uniform distribution; circular mean and standard deviation estimators (doubled angles for 0-180 deg)

recipe.goal: Re-measure Lupus PAs from continuum with three methods
recipe.method: CLEAN+imfit, uvmodelfit, and sparse modeling (PRIISM) with Gaussian fit and second-moment tensor; compare to published PAs
key_parameters: uvmodelfit up to 20 iterations; 20 (Lambda_l, Lambda_t) sets; 10-fold CV; MFISTA up to 1000 iterations; keep images with MSE < MSE_best+sigma

recipe.goal: Compare to magnetic field and filament
recipe.method: Alfvén Mach number from Planck polarization dispersion; field direction from Planck map with bilinear interpolation

evidence.quote: The statistical significance of this non-uniformity is barely $2\sigma$ ($p=0.037$)

answer_key.quantity: Kuiper p, Taurus / Upper Sco / Ophiuchus / L1688 / ONC
Delta PA mean and std vs Yen+2018 (22 overlap disks)

evidence.quote: the mean and the standard deviation of $\Delta$PA are $0.17^{\circ}$ and $30.9^{\circ}$, respectively

not_stated_but_needed: Which archival datasets/ASDM files map to which Lupus targets and which project each is from
